title: Infer the hidden state before choosing an action
description: Compare a latest-observation shortcut with a belief state that combines prior evidence, sensor reliability, and action effects.

representations.label: Latest observation only
representations.detail: Treat the current cue as the complete state and discard prior evidence.

representations.label: Action-conditioned belief state
representations.detail: Combine prior state, the noisy cue, and the selected action transition.

actions.label: Advance now
actions.detail: Make progress but increase exposure when the hidden path is blocked.

actions.label: Inspect from cover
actions.detail: Spend one control step to improve evidence before committing.

actions.label: Wait for a clearer view
actions.detail: Reduce immediate exposure but make limited progress.

scenarios.label: Occluded warehouse crossing
scenarios.context: A shelf hides the far lane; a partial silhouette appears near the crossing.
scenarios.hiddenState: A second robot may enter the lane from behind the shelf.

scenarios.label: Wet loading ramp
scenarios.context: The current frame looks clear, but recent wheel slip suggests changing friction.
scenarios.hiddenState: Low friction can persist even when the ramp looks visually normal.

scenarios.label: Delayed safety-door telemetry
scenarios.context: The door signal says closed, but its timestamp is older than the latest motion event.
scenarios.hiddenState: The door may have reopened after the delayed sensor sample.
